items.description: The automaker's revenue from operations stood at ₹13,069.59 crore during the April-June quarter, up 12 per cent year-on-year (Y-o-Y) from ₹11,708.54 crore.

items.description: For FII flows to accelerate - lower crude oil prices, rupee stability and two consecutive quarters of earnings delivery without downgrades seem must, says Jignesh Desai of Centrum Broking.

items.title: Ipca surges 11% in tepid market, nears 52-week high on healthy Q1 results

items.title: Bond yields surge after RBI announces early dollar deposit window closure
